zh.title: 華航預計2027年3月起調整一線人員名牌呈現方式
zh.summary: 中華航空預計自2027年3月起調整員工名牌；移除中文全名並標示姓氏與別名
body: 中華航空於2026年8月26日證實，因應第一線服務人員的實際職務需求，預計自民國116年（2027年）3月起，分階段換發服務類服制名牌。華航表示，新版名牌呈現方式將拿掉員工原本標示的中文全名，調整改為以中英文姓氏，並與英文名縮寫或外文別名擇一並列呈現。
華航說明，這次宣布調整一線服務人員服制名牌的標示方式，主要是考量第一線人員於工作場合的執勤特性與服務需求。透過修改名牌上的個人姓名資訊，可以在維持與旅客基本互動和識別功能的前提下，妥善保護員工個人隱私與執勤安全。
關於其他台灣國籍航空公司的相關做法，台灣虎航已於2026年2月1日起開放第一線人員申請新版工作證或名牌。第一線員工可依個人意願選擇是否申請，其新版名牌設計移除中文姓氏，並輔以英文別名，主要用於提供外籍旅客辨識與互動溝通。
長榮航空對此回應表示，基於第一線員工與旅客互動的工作特性，以及在適法前提下，長榮航空將持續研擬員工執勤配戴名牌的具體做法。
星宇航空則表示，第一線人員於日常執勤時，名牌維持標示中文全名及英文名，方便各國旅客辨識與溝通。不過在公關活動及拍攝場合，基於同仁隱私與安全考量，皆會事先遮蔽名牌資訊以避免姓名曝光。星宇航空強調，未來將持續研議合理的名牌呈現方式，秉持兼顧服務需求與員工隱私保護的原則。

en.title: China Airlines to Revise Frontline Staff Name Tag Format from March 2027
en.summary: China Airlines will revise frontline staff name tags starting March 2027, removing full Chinese names.
body: China Airlines confirmed on August 26, 2026, that it will adjust the display format of uniform name tags for frontline service personnel starting from March 2027. According to the carrier, the new name tags are scheduled to be issued in phases. The updated design will remove employees' full Chinese names and instead display Chinese and English surnames paired with either an English name abbreviation or a foreign alias.

China Airlines explained that the adjustment to frontline service name tags is being made in response to operational requirements and frontline duty characteristics. By modifying the presentation of personal identity details on name tags, the airline aims to maintain practical identification for passenger communication while protecting employee privacy and safety.

Regarding practices among other Taiwanese carriers, Tigerair Taiwan introduced an option on February 1, 2026, allowing frontline personnel to voluntarily apply for updated work credentials or name tags. Under Tigerair Taiwan's modified design, Chinese surnames are removed and supplemented with English aliases to facilitate recognition by foreign passengers.

EVA Airways stated that, based on the operational characteristics of frontline staff interaction with passengers and under applicable legal premises, it will continue to study practices for staff wearing name tags while on duty.

STARLUX Airlines noted that its frontline staff currently wear name tags displaying full Chinese and English names for daily duties to facilitate communication with passengers from different countries. However, during public relations events and filming, name tag information is masked in advance to protect employee privacy and safety. STARLUX Airlines added that it will continue evaluating reasonable name tag presentation formats under the principles of balancing service needs and staff privacy protection.

zh.title: 美軍MH-60黑鷹直升機於丹佛附近發生事故機上4人均未受傷
zh.summary: 美軍MH-60黑鷹直升機於丹佛附近訓練時發生事故；機上4名官兵均未受傷。
body: 美國陸軍第160特種作戰航空團的一架MH-60黑鷹直升機，於2026年8月25日在科羅拉多州丹佛附近的訓練飛行中墜落。機上4名機組人員均未受傷。
吉爾平郡警長辦公室表示，當局於當地時間上午11:30前接獲通報。該架直升機部位於丹佛以西約25英哩（40公里）處、黃金門峽谷州立公園以北的梭羅丁山東側。
美國陸軍特種作戰航空司令部透過警長辦公室發布聲明，確認知悉這起涉及4名士兵與1架MH-60黑鷹直升機的常規訓練航空事故。軍方與地方警方均未說明事故原因。

en.title: US Army MH-60 Black Hawk comes down near Denver during training; crew unhurt
en.summary: A US Army MH-60 Black Hawk came down near Denver during training, leaving all four crew unhurt.
body: A US Army MH-60 Black Hawk helicopter assigned to the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment came down during a training flight near Denver, Colorado, on August 25, 2026. All four crew members aboard escaped injury during the event.

According to the Gilpin County Sheriff's Office, local authorities were notified shortly before 11:30 local time. The aircraft came down on the eastern flank of Thorodin Mountain, located north of Golden Gate Canyon State Park and approximately 25 miles west of Denver.

The US Army Special Operations Aviation Command stated in a message through the sheriff's office that it was aware of the aviation mishap involving four soldiers during routine training operations. Neither military officials nor local authorities have provided a cause for the occurrence.

zh.title: 小琉球藍白1號因港口積淤擱淺 船上146人順利獲救
zh.summary: 小琉球客船藍白1號因港口淤泥累積發生擱淺；船上146人受困後獲救
body: 據臺灣媒體報導，於小琉球航線營運的客船「藍白1號」發生擱淺事故。初步報導指出，本起事件的主因係港口出現淤泥積聚情況，進而導致船隻在航行時無法順利通過而發生擱淺。
事故發生當時，該艘船隻因擱淺而受困於海中央，船上共有146名人員。現場隨後展開救援行動，協助受困人員離開該水域。
根據最新消息，受困於海中央的146人目前已全數平安獲救，本起事件未有更進一步的損害報告。相關港口積淤與處置細節仍有待後續說明。

en.title: Vessel Lan Bai 1 Runs Aground Off Xiaoliuqiu; All 146 On Board Rescued
en.summary: Vessel Lan Bai 1 ran aground in Xiaoliuqiu due to silt accumulation; 146 stranded passengers were rescued.
body: According to Taiwanese media reports, the passenger vessel Lan Bai 1 ran aground during its operation in Xiaoliuqiu. Initial reports indicate that the grounding incident occurred after silt accumulated in the port area, which hampered normal navigation.

Following the grounding, the vessel became immobilized in the middle of the sea with 146 individuals stranded on board. Emergency responders subsequently initiated a rescue operation to assist those trapped on the ship.

All 146 people aboard the stranded vessel have been successfully rescued. Relevant authorities have not reported any further injuries, and additional details regarding port maintenance remain subject to official verification.
